def factor_downside_vol_minus_upside_vol_ewm20(df):
    """Asymmetric volatility: difference between EWM downside and upside volatility of daily returns."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    down_sq = (ret.clip(upper=0) ** 2)
    up_sq = (ret.clip(lower=0) ** 2)
    down_vol = down_sq.ewm(span=20, min_periods=20).mean()
    up_vol = up_sq.ewm(span=20, min_periods=20).mean()
    df_copy["factor_downside_vol_minus_upside_vol_ewm20"] = down_vol - up_vol
    return df_copy["factor_downside_vol_minus_upside_vol_ewm20"]
description: Captures volatility asymmetry by comparing exponentially weighted moving variance of negative vs positive daily returns. Downside volatility is typically higher due to leverage effects and fear-driven selling. A positive factor value indicates that downside volatility dominates, which often precedes negative future returns.
